description: Natural terracotta square tile in an 8x8 inch format from Pak Clay, made for pathways, courtyards and garden walks. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour that sits comfortably beside planting and brick. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound, well-drained base and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Shade varies between pieces, so order a margin from one batch and mix pieces as you lay. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta tile set from Pak Clay combining picked and square pieces, a mixed layout suited to floors that should feel traditional and handmade rather than uniform. Fired clay carries a warm, earthy colour that comes from the material itself. Plan the pattern on the floor before fixing, because mixed shapes need careful setting-out. Clay is porous, so ask about a breathable sealer. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta rectangular tile in a 6x12 inch format from Pak Clay. The long shape suits running-bond, herringbone and straight layouts, and works on floors and feature walls. Fired clay gives a warm, natural colour that varies slightly from piece to piece. Herringbone needs extra pieces for edge cuts, so order a margin. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base and ask about a breathable sealer. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta rectangular tile in an 8x4 inch format from Pak Clay, a compact brick-proportion piece for floors, borders and walls. It can be laid in running bond or herringbone for a traditional clay look. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour, and tone varies naturally between pieces. Plan the layout first and order extra for cuts. Clay is porous, so use a sound base and ask about a breathable sealer. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
